title: Lattice-based Deep Neural Networks: Regularity and Tailored Regularization
summary: This survey article is concerned with the application of lattice rules to Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), lattice rules being a family of quasi-Monte Carlo methods. They have demonstrated effectiveness in various contexts for high-dimensional integration and function approximation. They are extremely easy to implement thanks to their very simple formulation -- all that is required is a good integer generating vector of length matching the dimensionality of the problem.
